title: One request through an ECS service on Fargate
claim: An ECS service runs tasks from an ECR image on Fargate, and the load balancer sends each request to one task.
alt: A VPC with private subnets in two Availability Zones. An Application Load Balancer sends requests to the Fargate tasks of one ECS service. The tasks pull their image from Amazon ECR and write to Amazon S3.

edges.say: The ECS service starts tasks on Fargate, and Fargate will try its best to spread tasks across Availability Zones.
The task execution role grants the Amazon ECS container and Fargate agents permission to pull the image from Amazon ECR.
The awsvpc mode provides each task with an elastic network interface, and the load balancer sends each request to one task.
The task role lets the application use other AWS services, such as Amazon S3.
